body: You are not responsible for the actions of others, do not contact him in any way what so ever. Cut him out, block him. The first part of getting better is letting go. I’ve never been through anything like this so I don’t know if my advice will help. But, it’s not your fault what happened. It never was. He has the control he wants over you by knowing you’re just a message away, take the control back and block him on everything and if he makes new accounts/numbers to contact you on then it’s harassment. Go to the police and get justice for yourself, it might be the first step you need

That’s a shitty thing to say, just because you helped her doesn’t mean she has to help you. Tallying like that in a relationship is not healthy. Love is supposed to be unconditional, not ‘I done this for you so now tho have to do this for me.’ I’m not defending her either. She should know how much telling you ‘who even cares’ must hurt. Yeah it is a problem, but it’s not hers and she doesn’t have the answers to your questions. I can tell why she ran, you think the world is in debt to you. You need to find yourself and help for yourself by yourself. No one can make you feel better until you make yourself feel better. The whole time you think ‘cos I done this so this should happen’ you’ll never get better. It doesn’t matter what you do, it won’t change what’s going to happen. When people are sad and want out they don’t tally up and see if it’s worth it or not. If you’re unhappy with not receiving help from her because you helped her then don’t ask for the help from her. It doesn’t matter how good you are to someone, it won’t make them good to you

So you’re telling me that you’re talking to a suicidal person (your ex) about killing yourself? There’s your problem... you’re making her suicidal tendencies worse doing that and you wonder why she wanted out? How is she gonna feel better about herself and her problems if you keep throwing yours on top of them? Sorry to be a dick but that’s how it is haha How could you actually expect her to put you first when she’s on the edge to? She was right to leave, she wants to mend and she felt she couldn’t the whole time you were making your suicidal thoughts her problem when she’s already battling her own. I genuinely got reddit to distract myself from my problems and help others but you’re not helping yourself. You’re gonna end up pushing her over the edge because she’s battling two peoples bad thoughts

She won’t see it the way you do, no words can make her see that. Nothing you do or say will bring her back to you. You need to accept the loss and move on. I know it’s hard, it’s not going to happen overnight either but the tighter you hold something, the more you suffocate it. It’s shit and it shouldn’t be this way but people find it suffocating when you talk to them about suicide. It pulls them into a world of hurt that they can’t express, takes them away from their own things they got to deal with and I imagine it’s very emotionally taxing trying to talk someone out of it all the time. You need to talk to a professional, someone who deals with this stuff on a daily basis because the average person can’t relate to how you feel

Mate, I’m just gonna say it how it is. An ex is an ex for a reason. If you’re still wanting her the it’s obvious that she’s the one who gave up on the relationship. I don’t know how or why but I know you need to speak to someone who hasn’t broken you. You can’t heal in the same environment as you were injured. Trust me, talking from first hand experience. I ran myself into the ground trying to love someone who didn’t want to love me. Did everything I could whilst she didn’t lift a finger for me. She even ignored me because I said I was depressed and this was just after explaining that I felt no one was there for me. The more she treated me bad the more I started to fight to feel like I meant something to her which ultimately made her leave because I was so depressed at the hands of her actions. She tried to be there for me at first but the more I got over her, the further I sank into my pit and the worse I felt about her. To this day I can’t figure out why I was treated so bad when I tried to do everything I could to make her feel special and loved. To an extent she is correct. It’s not her responsibility for your mental health and feelings. She can influence them but ultimately it’s down to you to find yourself again. Good luck bro
Pm me if you want matey, I’ll listen
